application_ready.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to express my interest in the Legal Associate / Legal Consultant position at Lux and Veritas International Legal Consultants. With 2+ years of post-qualification practice spanning intellectual property, commercial litigation, and regulatory compliance, I am drawn to your consultancy's focus on high-value international commercial matters and the opportunity to work across a diverse client portfolio in Dubai.

My background includes drafting and filing pleadings, motions, and legal notices across civil, commercial, and IP matters; conducting detailed legal research and preparing formal legal opinions; and representing clients directly before courts and tribunals in a multi-disciplinary practice environment. I am currently based in Dubai on a family-sponsored visa and am immediately available to begin.
